managePayments.heading: Payments
managePayments.state.not_connected.title: Not set up
managePayments.state.not_connected.body: Takes about 10 minutes. You will need your bank details and identity card.
managePayments.state.requirements.title: Stripe needs your details
managePayments.state.requirements.body: Card payments do not work until Stripe receives your business and bank details.
managePayments.state.pending.title: Connected — Stripe is checking your details
managePayments.state.pending.body: Nothing for you to do. Stripe is reviewing what you sent, and this page updates when they finish.
managePayments.state.ready.title: Connected
managePayments.state.ready.body: Your Stripe account is connected and ready to take payments.
managePayments.state.restricted.title: Card payments paused
managePayments.state.restricted.body: Stripe has paused card payments on your account until a problem is resolved.
managePayments.state.unsupported.title: Card payments cannot be had on this account
managePayments.state.unsupported.body: Stripe cannot enable card payments here. Get in touch with us and we will resolve it with you.
managePayments.keyMismatch.title: Stripe keys do not match
managePayments.keyMismatch.body: This site’s server uses the {server, select, live {live} other {test}} Stripe key, while the browser was built with the {browser, select, live {live} other {test}} key. Because card payments would fail at the very moment a customer tries to pay, setting up Stripe is blocked until the two keys match.
managePayments.keyMismatch.fix: Both keys must be set for the same environment and the site then rebuilt — the publishable key is included at build time, the secret key is read on every request.
managePayments.permission.title: Only the food truck’s owner can set up payments
managePayments.permission.body: Stripe is connected by the owner of the bank account that receives the money, so it must be set up after logging in to their own account. There is nothing wrong with this food truck or with HatchGrab.
managePayments.config.keyMissingTitle: Card payments are not configured yet
managePayments.config.fetchTitle: We could not check this food truck’s Stripe account
managePayments.config.keyMissing: {name} is not set — the embedded components cannot load.
managePayments.online.heading: Online payments
managePayments.online.body: Customers pay by card when they order. The money goes straight to your own Stripe account — we never hold it.
managePayments.online.feeLine: For standard {region}, Stripe charges {fee} per payment. Other cards may cost more. HatchGrab’s fee on online orders varies with your plan — see “Billing”.
managePayments.online.testMode: Test mode. Real payments cannot be taken yet.
managePayments.trialNote: Setting this up does not start your subscription and nothing is charged to you today. This is how your customers pay you — your plan is a separate thing.
managePayments.admin.title: Viewing as platform admin
managePayments.admin.body: This food truck has not set up online payments. Only the owner can start it, logged in to their own account — there is nothing to press here.
managePayments.toast.addDetails: Now add your details for Stripe
managePayments.onboarding.restricted: From here Stripe takes over — you will log in to Stripe and update the details it needs.
managePayments.onboarding.firstRun: From here Stripe takes over — you will log in to Stripe, then give your business and bank details.
managePayments.details.title: Your Stripe details
managePayments.details.body: Change the bank account you receive money into, or update your business details and documents.
managePayments.walkUp.heading: Payments for walk-up orders
managePayments.walkUp.body: How you take money at the food truck. Whatever you choose, HatchGrab charges no platform fee on walk-up orders.
managePayments.walkUp.ownTerminalHelp: Zettle, Square, or any one you already use. Nothing to set up — only your provider’s own fees apply.
managePayments.walkUp.hatchgrabHelp: Uses the same Stripe connection used for your online payments — a card machine, or contactless payments straight from your phone or tablet.
managePayments.walkUp.hatchgrabFees: {fee} per payment for {region}, plus {surcharge} for contactless payments taken with a phone or tablet. Other cards may cost more.
manageCharges.heading: Taxes, tips and fees
manageCharges.rate.label: Sales tax rate
manageCharges.rate.hint: The rate you charge on every order. Customers see it added at checkout, on receipts and on tickets.
manageCharges.rate.regionDefault: If left empty, {label} is charged: {rate}% — the rate for prepared food ({region}).
manageCharges.included.label: {label} included in your prices
manageCharges.included.hint: Your prices already include {label}. This rate only shows how much of each price is {label}, on receipts and tickets — nothing is added at checkout.
manageCharges.included.default: If left empty, {rate}% is used — the {label} rate for hot food sold as takeaway ({country}).
manageCharges.tips.label: Tips
manageCharges.tips.hint: Customers paying online by card can add a tip. All of it goes to you.
manageCharges.fee.label: Online service fee
manageCharges.fee.hint: Added to online orders only. Never on “Pay at the truck” orders or walk-up orders. It goes to you.
manageCharges.fee.example: Customers see it before paying, as one line: “{label} {amount}”.
manageCharges.fee.hatchgrab: HatchGrab adds a service fee ({fee}) to your customers’ online orders. You do not pay it and it cannot be changed.
manageCharges.saveFailed: Could not save — please try again.
takingPayment.heading: Taking payments
takingPayment.intro: How your team records money for each order.
takingPayment.paidStepHelp: Adds a “Confirm” button when you add an order yourself, so you can send it now and take payment later. Turn this on if you take orders by phone or in advance.
takingPayment.paidStepNote: This affects only orders you add. It does not affect online orders.

manageWhatsApp.preview.title: Try it before connecting
manageWhatsApp.preview.intro: Type a question the way a customer would ask it, and see exactly the reply they would get. Nothing is sent to anyone.
manageWhatsApp.preview.noReplyWhy: Because it looks like spam, a booking request or something unrelated, the auto-replies stay silent.
manageWhatsApp.preview.footnote: Replies are made by AI and vary slightly each time; they can sometimes be wrong.
manageWhatsApp.preview.failed: Could not make a preview right now.
manageWhatsApp.preview.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
manageWhatsApp.setup.popupHint: Can’t see the Facebook window? It may have been blocked. Allow pop-ups for hatchgrab.com, then press “Start again from the beginning”.
manageWhatsApp.notice.sdkUnavailable: WhatsApp setup is not available in this environment.
manageWhatsApp.notice.sdkBlocked: Meta’s login script could not load. The usual cause is an ad blocker or tracking protection.
manageWhatsApp.notice.setupFailed: Setup could not be completed. Nothing was changed.
manageWhatsApp.notice.metaError: Meta reported a problem during setup. Nothing was changed. Try again, and contact us if it keeps happening.
manageWhatsApp.notice.closed: Setup was closed before it finished. Nothing was changed — press “Set up” to try again.
manageWhatsApp.notice.disconnectedUnreac: WhatsApp is disconnected. We could not reach Meta to remove access. Please remove HatchGrab in WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.
manageWhatsApp.notice.disconnected: WhatsApp is disconnected. Auto-replies have stopped.
manageWhatsApp.card.title: Auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.card.description: Answer customer questions on your social media automatically, using your menu and schedule.
manageWhatsApp.card.requiresAccount: A WhatsApp Business account is needed.
manageWhatsApp.card.popupInstruction: A Facebook window will open to connect your WhatsApp Business account. If nothing appears, allow pop-ups for hatchgrab.com in your browser, then press “Set up” again.
manageWhatsApp.card.switchedOff: WhatsApp auto-replies are switched off for your food truck.
manageWhatsApp.card.expiring: Your WhatsApp connection must be renewed soon. Press “Reconnect” to keep auto-replies running.
manageWhatsApp.card.instagram: Auto-replies to Instagram direct messages. An Instagram professional account will be needed.
manageWhatsApp.card.messenger: Auto-replies to Facebook Messenger. A Facebook Page will be needed.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.title: Your replies are not being delivered
manageWhatsApp.blocked.body: Because of a billing problem on your WhatsApp Business account, WhatsApp is refusing to send your automatic replies. Customers can still message you and you still see everything they send — but they get no reply.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.fix: Because you pay WhatsApp directly for these messages, this is fixed in WhatsApp Manager. <link>Check your payment method</link>
manageWhatsApp.limit.heading: Auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.limit.label: Monthly limit
manageWhatsApp.limit.perCustomer: Up to {n} replies per customer within 24 hours, then one message saying you will reply personally.
manageWhatsApp.limit.emailAt: Replies stop when you reach your limit. We will email you at 80% and 100%.
manageWhatsApp.billing.heading: Billing
manageWhatsApp.billing.summary: It is Meta, not HatchGrab, that bills your WhatsApp account for replies. From {from} the first {free, number} replies a month are free. Correct as of {checked}; see <link>Meta’s pricing</link> for changes.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesTitle: It is Meta, not HatchGrab, that charges for WhatsApp replies.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesBody: Every reply HatchGrab sends for you is billed by Meta to your WhatsApp Business account. From {from}, Meta gives {free, number} free replies a month per number; after that every reply is charged at Meta’s rate. Replies you send yourself from the WhatsApp Business app are not charged. Meta sets these prices and they may change. <link>See Meta’s pricing</link>
manageWhatsApp.billing.addPaymentInManag: Add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveMissing: Your limit is above Meta’s free replies ({free, number}). Without a payment method, Meta stops all replies once those are used.
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveGeneral: Your limit is above Meta’s free replies ({free, number}). Replies beyond that need a payment method on your WhatsApp account; without one, Meta stops all replies once the free replies are used.
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.title: Disconnect WhatsApp?
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.body: Auto-replies stop immediately and HatchGrab loses access to your WhatsApp account. Your number keeps working in the WhatsApp Business app. To remove HatchGrab completely, also open WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.
manageWhatsApp.signup.partial: We connected your WhatsApp Business account, but could not complete the connection. Nothing is wrong on your side — please contact us and we will finish it.
manageWhatsApp.signup.noNumber: Your WhatsApp Business account is connected, but no phone number came back. Press “Reconnect” and finish the number step.
manageWhatsApp.signup.needsRegistering: Your account is connected, but this number must be registered by us before replies can start. Please contact the support team — your setup is saved, do not run it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.registerRefused: Your account is connected, but Meta refused to register the number. Your setup is saved — please contact the support team instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.deliveryRefused: Your account is connected, but Meta refused to turn on message delivery. Your setup is saved — please contact the support team instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.numberTaken: That WhatsApp number is already connected to another HatchGrab account. A number can answer for only one food truck. Contact the support team and we will move it across.
manageWhatsApp.signup.saveIncomplete: Very close — we could not finish saving. Your setup is saved; please contact the support team instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.connected: WhatsApp is connected. Auto-replies will start answering messages that come to this number.
customDomain.card.title: Add your schedule to your website
customDomain.card.create: We will create a page showing your schedule at the address <addr>{address}</addr>.
customDomain.card.justLive: {address} is working. Look at it and tell us below that it is right.
customDomain.waiting.title: We are waiting for {address}
customDomain.waiting.bodySince: Date you set this up: {date}. New web addresses usually start working within a few minutes; sometimes it can take up to 24 hours to reach everyone — there is nothing you need to do meanwhile. If someone else was adding the line for you, it is worth checking they did it.
customDomain.waiting.body: New web addresses usually start working within a few minutes; sometimes it can take up to 24 hours to reach everyone — there is nothing you need to do meanwhile. If someone else was adding the line for you, it is worth checking they did it.
customDomain.ready.title: {address} is live
customDomain.ready.body: Look at it and tell us in your settings that it is right.
customDomain.confirm.heading: Have a look, then tell us it is right
customDomain.confirm.checkTimes: Check the dates and times are right.
customDomain.confirm.problemLine: Tell us what you are seeing and we will look into it.
customDomain.confirmed.heading: Thank you — all of that is noted.
customDomain.confirmed.body: There is nothing else to do.
customDomain.turnOff.heading: Turn off your own web address?
customDomain.turnOff.carriesOn: This keeps working exactly as it is now; it is also where your QR code sends people:
customDomain.turnOff.reAdd: If you will set it up again later, leave the line you added at your web address company as it is. If not, ask them to remove it.
customDomain.turnOff.failed: We could not turn that off right now. Nothing has changed — your address still works. Try again in a little while.
customDomain.wizard.resumeFailedTitle: We could not load your setup.
customDomain.wizard.resumeFailedBody: Nothing has changed. Try again in a little while.
customDomain.address.intro: Your schedule gets its own web address.
customDomain.address.question: What is your web address?
customDomain.address.hint: The one people already use to find you.
customDomain.address.noChange: Your website does not change — you only add a link to the new address.
customDomain.address.notSetUp: We have not set this up.
customDomain.address.restricted: Whoever looks after your web address must allow us to set up the padlock sign — the small lock customers see beside the address. It will not appear until they add us, so instead of leaving you waiting for it we stopped. Ask them to add us, then try again.
customDomain.address.blocked: Your web address currently blocks the padlock sign completely. Before this can work, whoever looks after it must allow it. Ask them to change that, then try again.
customDomain.address.elsewhere: Something is already running at that address. Send the message on the next screen to whoever looks after it — they will know what to do.
customDomain.address.provider: Your web address is looked after by: {provider}. We will show you where to go.
customDomain.address.provisionFailed: We could not set up that address.
customDomain.address.couldNotBeSetUp: That address could not be set up.
customDomain.apex.empty: Type the address you would like to use.
customDomain.apex.not_a_domain: That does not look like a web address.
customDomain.apex.unparseable: We could not read that as a web address. Check the spelling and try again.
customDomain.apex.apex: {host} — this is your whole website address. If you point it at us, this page replaces your website. Put a word in front of it instead — for example events.{host}.
customDomain.apex.too_deep: That address has too many parts. Something like events.{domain} works best.
customDomain.record.addAtSave: Add this at the {provider} service and save.
customDomain.record.addSomewhere: Add this where your web address is looked after, and save.
customDomain.record.hintWord: This word only, not the whole address.
customDomain.record.timing: It usually starts working within an hour, but it can take longer. You do not need to keep this page open.
customDomain.record.someoneElse: Does someone else look after your web address?
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.open: Open your web address, then choose “DNS” and “Records”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.add: Choose “Add record”, then choose “CNAME” as the “Type”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.value: Put the second value below in “Target”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.proxy: Set “Proxy status” to “DNS only” — the cloud beside it must be grey, not orange.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.caveat: If the cloud stays orange the padlock sign will never appear, and nothing says why.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.open: Open your “Domain Portfolio” and choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.add: Choose “Add New Record”, then choose “CNAME” from the “Type” menu.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.save: Leave “TTL” as it is and choose “Save”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.caveat: If you added more than one at once, the button says “Save All Records”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.signIn: Log in to your “123 Reg Control Panel”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.manage: Beside “Domains”, choose “Manage All”, then choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.123reg.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.value: Put the second value below in “Value”, and add a full stop (.) to its end.
customDomain.providers.123reg.caveat: 123 Reg needs a full stop at the end of the second value, otherwise it will not work.
customDomain.providers.wix.open: Open “Domains”, then click the “Domain Actions” icon beside your web address.
customDomain.providers.wix.add: In the “CNAME (Aliases)” section click “+ Add Record”, then click “Got it”.
customDomain.providers.wix.name: Put the first value below in “Host Name”.
customDomain.providers.wix.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.wix.save: Click “Save”, then click “Save Changes” in the pop-up window.
customDomain.providers.wix.caveat: If your web address is not held at Wix but only points to Wix, Wix cannot make this change — whoever holds it must do it.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.subject: One record (record) to add for the schedule page — {truckName}
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introAt: We are putting our live schedule ({truckName}) at the address {address}, and for that one record must be added to our domain at the {provider} service.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introHold: We are putting our live schedule ({truckName}) at the address {address}, and for that one record must be added to our domain through the organisation that holds it.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.wholeChan: That is all the change needed — nothing else on the website is affected, and the rest of our domain works exactly as it does now. It usually starts working within an hour.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.pointsAt: The page it points at shows where we are trading next and updates itself.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.replyTo: If you have any questions, reply to this address: {email}
customDomain.liveEmail.subject: {address} is working
customDomain.liveEmail.body: Your schedule now shows at your own address. Look at it and check it is right: open {address}, and make sure the events are yours and the dates are correct.
customDomain.liveEmail.confirm: After you have done that, open your settings on HatchGrab and tell us it is right. Nothing depends on it — it only means we know someone has seen it.
deleteAccount.scheduled: This account is scheduled to be deleted
deleteAccount.requested: Date requested: {requested}. Date it is due to be deleted: {due}.
deleteAccount.orderingStopped: Online orders have stopped. Until then your dashboard is available to read.
deleteAccount.cannotCancelPending: You cannot cancel this yourself. To stop it, email {email} as soon as possible.
deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.body: Permanently close this HatchGrab account and stop taking online orders.
deleteAccount.stopsImmediately: Online orders stop immediately — not in 30 days. As soon as you confirm, customers cannot order from you.
deleteAccount.upcoming: You have {count, plural, one {# upcoming orders} other {# upcoming orders}}. These still need to be fulfilled.
deleteAccount.allTrucks: All vehicles on this account are included ({count} vehicles): {names}.
deleteAccount.deletedAfter: Your account will be deleted after 30 days. During that time your dashboard is available to read.
deleteAccount.cannotCancel: You cannot cancel this yourself. To stop it, you must email <link>{email}</link>.
deleteAccount.whatHeading: What is deleted and what is kept
deleteAccount.whatPersonal: Your and your team’s personal details are deleted, and your logins are removed.
deleteAccount.whatCustomers: Your customers’ names, emails and phone numbers are deleted from your orders.
deleteAccount.whatAccounting: As required by UK law, anonymous accounting records are kept for six years. See our privacy policy.
deleteAccount.copyFirst: Want a copy of your data first? There is no download in the app. You have a right to get a copy — email {email} before you confirm, and we will send it to you.
deleteAccount.requestedToast: Account deletion requested. Check your email.
copyButton.announceFailed: Could not copy: {thing}. Select the writing and copy it yourself.
copyButton.announceFailedValue: Could not copy the value. Select the writing and copy it yourself.
